notes.title: A New Chapter: “Devi - A Light in the Dark” & Demo Playtest Invitation
notes.content:
We want to share how your voices have shaped DEVI: A Light in the Dark —a reimagined narrative mystery born from the heart of MISSING.  

[b]Why DEVI?[/b]
The shift to Devi—a 15-year-old detective in rural India—stems from our mission to 'balance social impact with engaging gameplay'. While Champa’s story remains foundational, we realized that Devi’s perspective could:  
[list]
[*] Amplify Player Agency: Solve mysteries through clue-driven detective work, stealth, and morally complex choices.  
[*] Broaden Reach: Highlight systemic issues (caste divides, trafficking) through a relatable, empowering lens.  
[*] Preserve Authenticity: Explore rural India’s vibrant villages, where societal rot hides beneath tradition.  
[/list]

We believe, if you play the demo you will feel. this isn’t a departure from MISSING’s mission—it’s an evolution to ensure the game resonates deeply while driving change. 

[b]What’s New? [/b]
Rewritten Story: New characters, locations, and branching narratives.  
Innovative Mechanics: Analyze conversations, detect lies, and unlock hidden dialogues to progress. 
Cultural Depth: Authentic settings rarely seen in games, paired with voice acting and 3D environments.

Showcase at Comic Con India: As we speak, Devi is featured in Comic Con India coupled with a festival on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39148559/97f8e782ca015d47fd7cb8e9e40deabb443eecda.jpg[/img]

[b]Your Role in This Journey[/b]
Playtest the Demo: Help us refine DEVI! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661290/Devi__A_light_in_the_dark_Demo/]Link[/url]
If for any reason you are unable to check the demo in you country. Here's an alternate [url=https://flyingrobotstudios.itch.io/devi]download link[/url].

[b]Feedback Matters: [/b]
Share your thoughts via 
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeiZD4j5A-Tj1JT28AwzTX_ZsiWIv4ss7rWOJm4406wgE3k3w/viewform?usp=header]This form[/url]
—your input directly shapes the final game.  

Gratitude & Next Steps
We know this pivot has sparked mixed emotions. Your passion for MISSING’s original vision fuels our commitment to honoring its spirit through DEVI. This isn’t an ending—it’s a new dawn for storytelling that matters.  

Stay tuned for gameplay trailers, screenshots, and deeper dives into Devi’s world. Together, we’ll #IlluminateTheDarkness.  

With gratitude,  
Team DEVI
